title: camera_script
description: M10B: schema for the *.camera.ron multi-camera authoring scripts consumed by cf-replay-export::camera_director. The author declares up to 4 camera kinds (free_cam / follow_player / objective_cam / kill_cam), each with a half-open [start_tick, end_tick) routing window and >=1 keyframes. Per-tick pose between keyframes is computed via cubic Catmull-Rom interpolation (VAL-M10B-024 / VAL-M10B-025). Per spec, pose is [f32; 6] = (x, y, zoom, rotation, lookahead_x, lookahead_y).

tracks.description: One entry per camera track. Tracks MUST NOT have overlapping [start_tick, end_tick) windows; the loader rejects overlap with CameraScriptError::OverlappingRange.

kind.description: Camera kind. Loader rejects unknown values with CameraScriptError::UnknownCameraKind.

start_tick.description: Inclusive start tick of this track's routing window.

end_tick.description: Exclusive end tick of this track's routing window.

tick.description: Sim tick at which the keyframe is anchored.

pose.description: Pose vector: (x, y, zoom, rotation, lookahead_x, lookahead_y). f32 precision per spec; finite-only -- loader rejects NaN / +Inf / -Inf with CameraScriptError::NonFinitePose.
